    Weight-homogeneous lifts for A⁽²⁾ = 𝔽₂P (Proposition 10.1) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "lifting a basis of H_ℤ to mesh weights by Lemma 7.4 gives the modules M_i⁽²⁾ compatible weight gradings, and the corrections can be chosen in each weight component."

    For the table tab₂ of A⁽²⁾ and any mesh weight W (with values in any abelian group), the ray weights are the restriction of W (hvW, Lemma 7.4's MeshWt.rv), and the ray basis vectors Θ₂(b_r) = e_r of A⁽²⁾ are homogeneous of these weights (hΘ₂): e_r is the matrix unit of a path of the deck degree of r (eT_eq_path). So the weight-homogeneous lifts hold for A⁽²⁾ with no further hypothesis (exists_modLiftW₂, exists_arrowLiftW₂).

      Proposition 10.1, weight-homogeneous module lifts for A⁽²⁾ = 𝔽₂P: for any mesh weight W and any finite family of integer coordinates, every evaluated module M_X⁽²⁾ lifts to 𝒪 = ℤ/4 with an action homogeneous for the degree and for every coordinate of the restricted ray weights.

      Proposition 10.1, weight-homogeneous arrow lifts for A⁽²⁾ = 𝔽₂P: the arrow maps lift to maps of degree one, homogeneous of the weight of the arrow for every coordinate.
